all_workflows.source:
name: Lean
on:
  push:
    branches-ignore:
      - light-eft-spanners-checkpoints
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: paper-formalizations-single-compiler
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    outputs:
      validated_commit: ${{ steps.full_validated.outputs.commit }}
    if: github.ref != 'refs/heads/light-eft-spanners-checkpoints'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Full sequential kernel replay grows with the all-papers library.
    # Keep every replay; the preceding 30-minute ceiling interrupted clean progress.
    timeout-minutes: 120
    # Bounded pinned-source review: trusted Lake/compiler paths serialize
    # with one task worker. Not a semaphore for arbitrary future custom tasks.
    env:
      LEAN_NUM_THREADS: '1'
      LIGHTEFT_VALIDATION_ROLE: full
      LIGHTEFT_EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: leanprover/lean-action@a1e4f67744f24ab80ec3c7ab1bd37d7d419207d5
        with:
          auto-config: "false"
          build: "true"
          test: "false"
          lint: "false"
          use-mathlib-cache: "true"
          mk_all-check: "false"
          axiom-audit: "true"
          axiom-audit-root: "VFTSpanners"
          axiom-audit-allow: "propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound"
      - name: Check all paper module indexes
        run: bash scripts/CheckModuleIndex.sh
      - name: Verify paid flag serialization and stored filter composition
        id: light_eft_paid_focused
        env:
          LIGHTEFT_JOB_WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ job.workflow_ref }}
          LIGHTEFT_JOB_WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ job.workflow_sha }}
          LIGHTEFT_JOB_WORKFLOW_PATH: ${{ job.workflow_file_path }}
          LIGHTEFT_JOB_WORKFLOW_REPOSITORY: ${{ job.workflow_repository }}
          PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/light-eft-paid-focused-python-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: python3 -B checkpoints/light-eft-paid-focused-adapter-20261020/ci_gate.py
      - name: Preserve paid producer evidence immediately
        if: ${{ always() && steps.light_eft_paid_focused.outcome != 'skipped' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: light-eft-paid-focused-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/light-eft-paid-focused-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Strictly verify actual stored-edge sample construction and voting
        run: |
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredEdgeMembership.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredRecordEncoding.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredRecordExecutable.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredRecordMachine.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredRecordTrace.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredSampleEncoding.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredSampleEntry.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteBound.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteEncoding.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteExecutable.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteMachine.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredVoteTrace.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredRecordSmoke.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredVoteSmoke.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredVoteSafetyAudit.lean"
      - name: Strictly verify stored host and candidate traversal

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredCandidateTrace.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true --run "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredHostSmoke.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/verification/StoredHostSafetyAudit.lean"

          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredPreparedHostOriginal.lean"
          lake env lean -DautoImplicit=false -DwarningAsError=true "Light Edge Fault Tolerant Graph Spanners/LightEFTSpanners/StoredPreparedHostRecords.lean"

name: LightEFT exact-source sequential gate
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      source:
        description: Frozen exact source commit
        required: true
        type: string
      harness:
        description: Reviewed immutable verification-harness commit
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: paper-formalizations-single-compiler
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  verify:
    if: inputs.source == '78cb40c7837db049d645d73696f2e0b724ce8a3b' && inputs.harness == 'ded293f2e4b17405cd009c5ba65acf913154b139'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source }}
          path: tested
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.harness }}
          path: harness
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install hash-pinned official Lean
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p tested/ci-evidence
          {
            curl -fLSs --retry 3 https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/releases/download/v4.34.0/lean-4.34.0-linux.tar.zst -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean.tar.zst"
            echo "caaa98356098c85dc0fcbbd28e1ec66f39eb6551829972b752ff20e1286b646b  $RUNNER_TEMP/lean.tar.zst" | sha256sum -c -
            tar --zstd -xf "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean.tar.zst" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          } 2>&1 | tee tested/ci-evidence/toolchain-install.log
      - name: Clean exact-source strict compilation, replay and audit
        working-directory: tested
        env:
          SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.source }}
          HARNESS_COMMIT: ${{ inputs.harness }}
        run: python3 ../harness/scripts/LightEFTExactCI.py "$SOURCE_COMMIT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean-4.34.0-linux" "$HARNESS_COMMIT"
      - name: Preserve complete evidence, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: light-eft-exact-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: tested/ci-evidence
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

# Local review candidate only: never pushed, dispatched or executed.
name: Light EFT noncompiler component diagnostics
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - light-eft-spanners-checkpoints
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/light-eft-noncompiler-diagnostics.yml
      - checkpoints/light-eft-noncompiler-harness-20261022/**
concurrency:
  group: paper-formalizations-single-compiler
  cancel-in-progress: false
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  diagnostic:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/light-eft-spanners-checkpoints' && github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    env:
      LEAN_NUM_THREADS: '1'
      LIGHTEFT_DIAGNOSTIC_BINDINGS_SHA: 455035af219af48ab89c6a3b8ab7301bf754e25c150765178b25cf0dde97c6f9
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Authenticate and run reviewed noncompiler Python entry only
        env:
          LIGHTEFT_JOB_WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ job.workflow_sha }}
          LIGHTEFT_JOB_WORKFLOW_PATH: ${{ job.workflow_file_path }}
          LIGHTEFT_JOB_WORKFLOW_REPOSITORY: ${{ job.workflow_repository }}
          LIGHTEFT_JOB_WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ job.workflow_ref }}
        shell: /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -p -e -o pipefail {0}
        run: |
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -B - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import hashlib
          p = Path('checkpoints/light-eft-noncompiler-harness-20261022/launcher.py').resolve()
          b = p.read_bytes()
          if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() != 'df88070a9178474d941751a8a13d6f8c0f7a85463ddbf01a2f4ce4fd2528ef50':
              raise SystemExit('Unreviewed diagnostic entry bytes')
          exec(compile(b, str(p), 'exec'), {'__name__': '__main__', '__file__': str(p)})
          PY
      - name: Preserve diagnostic evidence including admission or component failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: light-eft-noncompiler-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/light-eft-noncompiler-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
